_help: MCP servers the agents may use. Each runs inside the tools container, which has internet but none of your files or Mission Control's keys. env: only the variables named here reach that server; "$NAME" is read from tools/.env. readOnly: true marks every tool of the server as read-only; otherwise a tool is read-only only if it says so itself (readOnlyHint), and per-tool settings under tools override both. Tools that change things are refused until approvals for tools exist.

demo.description: A built-in test server: echo text back, tell the time, and a pretend note writer (it changes nothing, but says it would)
